verdict.rationale: Notion documents a Marketplace where vetted public OAuth connections are listed and discoverable to all users. Its integrations directory shows concrete third-party connections (GitHub, Loom, Tableau, Mixpanel, Canva, Calendly, Sketch) for syncing data and automating workflows. missing for 10: evidence of the 'thousands' scale of the catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration of installing marketplace apps.
